content: transbank-sdk Python 6.1.0 (PyPI current, GitHub master source): Transaction is instance-based (WebpayTransaction): tx = Transaction.build_for_integration(IntegrationCommerceCodes.WEBPAY_PLUS, IntegrationApiKeys.WEBPAY). create(buy_order,session_id,amount,return_url) validates max lengths 26/61/255 (ApiConstants), amount is float; commit(token) does PUT .../transactions/{token}; status(token) GET same path; errors raise TransactionCreateError/TransactionCommitError/TransactionStatusError. Integration constants: WEBPAY_PLUS='597055555532', API key WEBPAY='579B532A7440BB0C9079DED94D31EA1615BACEB56610332264630D42D0A36B1C' (public). Endpoint /rswebpaytransaction/api/webpay/v1.2. SDK uses sync requests -> call from sync routes (STACK.md concursa).
